Right chain 120 / 160D / 100 / 160D-120Em / 70 | 40 | 135 / 160D / 120 / 160D / 120 / 160D / 145 | 40 | 90 / 180E / 140 = 2100: cap tops 120, 380, 785, 1065, 1345, 1780. The sheet's '**' box (1190 x 900 at x 175, y 700: the sheet's '1190' / '900') takes Symbol A or Symbol B of page 2: both generated as variants, each the sheet PDF's own vector artwork.
